name: Build scripts
description: Trigger admin-configured build programs (e.g. static-site builds) on an external build daemon from the Drupal UI and stream their logs.
project_description: Build scripts adds a UI (toolbar button plus admin pages) that lets an authorized operator kick off named build "stages" and watch the streamed output. It does not run any shell command itself: the Drupal module is a thin HTTP client that POSTs the selected stage and current language to an external build daemon (https://github.com/oikeuttaelaimille/builder), which owns the OS permissions and actually runs the shell script. This separation is deliberate so the web-server process never needs build/deploy privileges. It was written to run Gatsby static-site builds from Drupal content, with support for separate testing/live environments, but the stage list is free-form so it can drive any script the daemon exposes. Configuration is a daemon address plus a list of stage names; the module is inert without the daemon running.
